info.title: Help desk core API
info.description: API of the help desk core.

get.summary: Customers that can get tickets, with their mail domains. Scope `directory:read`.
A customer's active assets. Scope `directory:read`.
The active services a customer uses. Scope `directory:read`.

post.summary:
Proposes something to the agents; it replaces the open proposal of the same kind on the same
message or ticket. Scope `proposals:write`.

get.summary:
Tickets that are not closed, of a requester or a customer, most recent first (at most 50).
Scope `tickets:read`.

parameters.name: requester_email
parameters.description: Tickets of the requester this address belongs to (any of their addresses).

get.summary: A ticket with its messages and links, without internal notes. Scope `tickets:read`.
The add-on the token belongs to, and what it may do.
Every add-on with its deliveries; never its token or event secret.

put.summary: Switches an add-on on (its token works, its waiting events go out) or off.

get.summary: Every agent, deactivated ones last.

post.summary: Adds an agent with a generated password.
Deactivates an agent who left the help desk.
Gives the agent a new, generated password and ends their sessions.
Lets a deactivated agent sign in again.

get.summary: What reading and sending mail last did since the core started, and the outbox.
Every permission a role can hold, in the product's order.
Every role, the Administrator first. Those who manage agents need it to give roles.

post.summary: Creates a role.

put.summary: Renames a role and replaces its permissions.

delete.summary: Removes a role no agent has.

post.summary: Makes the role the one new agents get when none is named.

get.summary: Agents who are not deactivated, by name: those a ticket can be assigned to.

put.summary: Changes an asset's kind and name.

post.summary: Retires an asset: it stays on its tickets but gets no new links.

get.summary: Customers that can get new tickets (offboarded ones are left out), by name.
Every customer, offboarded ones included (last), with counts.

post.summary: Adds a customer.

get.summary: A customer with its domains and requesters.
The customer's assets, active ones first.

post.summary: Adds an asset the customer owns.
Registers a mail domain: mail from it opens tickets for this customer.

delete.summary: Unregisters a mail domain. Requesters already registered from it stay.

post.summary: Offboards a customer: no new tickets, its mail waits in the inbox, its history stays.
Registers a requester with the customer.

get.summary: The services the customer uses.

post.summary: Adds a site to the customer; the customer's active sites have different names.

get.summary: Whether the core and its database are up.
Messages waiting in the inbox, oldest first.

post.summary: Attaches an inbox message to an existing ticket.
Discards an inbox message. It stays stored but leaves the inbox.
Opens a ticket for an inbox message; its sender becomes the ticket's requester.

Accepts a proposal: it is applied as if the agent did it. A draft reply comes back to be put
in the composer; nothing is sent.
Discards a proposal.

Gives a requester one more e-mail address; mail from it identifies them too. An address that
already belongs to a requester is refused.

delete.summary: Takes an e-mail address from a requester, who keeps at least one.

get.summary: Every service the help desk provides, active ones first.

post.summary: Adds a service; the help desk's own organization uses it from the start.

get.summary: A service with the customers that use it and the assets it runs on.

put.summary: Renames a service or changes its description.
Records that the service runs on the asset.

delete.summary: Records that the service no longer runs on the asset.

put.summary: The customer starts using the service.

delete.summary: The customer stops using the service (refused while its tickets refer to it).

post.summary: Retires a service: it stays on its tickets but gets no new links or users.

get.summary: The signed-in agent, with what their role allows.

post.summary: Signs an agent in and sets the session cookie.

put.summary: Changes the signed-in agent's password; their other sessions end.
Corrects a site's name and address; a retired site too.

post.summary:
Retires a site: it stays visible but gets no new requesters or assets. Sites are never
deleted.

get.summary: Tickets, most recently updated first (at most 200).

parameters.name: assignee
parameters.description: `me` (the signed-in agent), `none` (unassigned) or an agent's id.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description:
Text found in the title, any of the requester's addresses or the customer's name; `#12` or
`12` also finds ticket 12.

post.summary: Opens a ticket by hand.

get.summary: A ticket with its messages and notes.

put.summary: Links an asset of the ticket's customer to the ticket.

delete.summary: Unlinks an asset from the ticket.

put.summary: Sets or clears the ticket's assignee.
Moves the ticket to another customer, for when it was assigned to the wrong one.

get.summary: The signed-in agent's unsent draft on the ticket, or null.

put.summary: Saves the signed-in agent's draft on the ticket. Sending a reply or a note clears it.

post.summary: Adds an internal note, seen only by agents.

put.summary: Makes the ticket a child of a parent ticket of the help desk's own organization.

delete.summary: Detaches the ticket from its parent.

post.summary: Queues a reply to the ticket's requester. It is sent by e-mail shortly after.
Resolves every open or waiting child of this parent ticket, replying to each requester.

put.summary: Links a service the ticket's customer uses to the ticket.

delete.summary: Unlinks a service from the ticket.

put.summary: Moves the ticket to another state. A closed ticket never changes.

reply_body.description: For a draft reply: the text to put in the composer. Nothing has been sent.

ticket_number.description: The ticket the proposal opened or acted on, when there is one.

Activity.description: The last outcome of reading or sending mail.

last_error.description: The last failure since the core started, with any credentials taken out.

last_success_at.description: Reading: the last read that worked. Sending: the last message sent.

server.description: The server's host and port; never the credentials.

password.description: The new agent's first password, generated; it is not shown again.

domains.description: Mail domains that identify the customer's requesters.

languages.description: The languages of the agents' UI: write each rationale in all of them.

AddonRow.description: An add-on as the command line and those who manage add-ons see it; never its secrets.

failing.description: Undelivered events whose delivery has failed at least once.

last_error.description: Why the latest failed delivery failed.

requester_email.description:
The address a reply goes to: the one the requester last wrote from on the ticket, else the
one an agent last picked there, else the first they registered.

administrator.description: Whether the agent's role is the Administrator role.

permissions.description: Everything the agent's role allows beyond reading; every permission for an Administrator.

AgentAccount.description: An agent as those who manage agents see them.

administrator.description: Whether the agent's role is the Administrator role.

deactivated_at.description: When the agent was deactivated; empty while they work at the help desk.

kind.description: What sort of thing it is: computer, printer, application, licence…

source_addon.description: The add-on it came from, when an add-on supplies it.

kind.description: What sort of thing it is: computer, printer, application, licence…

agent_id.description: The agent responsible from now on; null leaves the ticket unassigned.

ticket_number.description: The number of the ticket the message belongs to.

allOf.description: What to do with an inbox message.

oneOf.description: What to do with an inbox message.
Assets of the ticket's customer the ticket is about.
Services the ticket's customer uses that the ticket is about.
A draft reply to the requester; accepting it puts it in the agent's composer.

requester.description:
When the ticket has a requester: move the requester (and all of their tickets) too, or
remove the requester from this ticket.

sites.description: The customer's sites, active ones first.

is_help_desk.description: Whether this is the help desk's own organization.
Whether this is the help desk's own organization.

unassigned.description: Tickets that lost the agent as their assignee.

Direction.description: Whether the help desk received a message or sent it.

body.description: The text so far; empty removes the draft.

DraftMode.description: Whether the draft is a reply to the requester or an internal note.

FailingReply.description: A reply the outbox has not managed to send yet.

given_up.description: The outbox has stopped trying (crate::outbound::MAX_ATTEMPTS); the message stays unsent.

GeneratedPassword.description: A password made by the core, shown once to the agent who asked for it.

oneOf.description: The open triage proposal of an add-on, if any.

from_address.description: The address replies come from; null when agents cannot reply.

oneOf.description: Reading the mailbox; null when no mailbox is configured.
Sending replies; null when no server is configured, and replies wait in the outbox.

author_name.description: The agent who wrote an outbound message.

gave_up.description: The outbox stopped trying: the message will not be sent.

last_error.description: Why the last attempt to send it failed.

sent_at.description: When an outbound message left; empty while it waits in the outbox.

unlinked.description: How many asset and service links were removed because they did not fit the new customer.

role_id.description: The role; omitted, the default role.

domains.description: Mail domains of the customer's requesters, e.g. `brightfield.test`.

rationale.description:
Why the add-on suggests it: one sentence per UI language (`{"en": "...", "it": "..."}`,
see `languages` in whoami), or a single English sentence.

oneOf.description: The state the ticket moves to; waiting (for the requester) when omitted.

to.description:
One of the requester's addresses, picked by the agent on a ticket the requester has not
written on; needed then when they have several. Where they last wrote from on the ticket,
the reply goes there, and any other address is refused.

note.description: An internal note recording what was said, e.g. on the phone.

requester_email.description:
The requester's address; a new one is registered with the customer. Omit it for planned
work without a requester.

customer_id.description: The customer the new ticket belongs to.

failing.description: Replies that failed at least once, most attempted first (at most 50).

parent_number.description: The number of the help desk's ticket that tracks the failure.

Permission.description:
Something beyond reading that a role allows. The list is the product's; the database checks
stored permissions against it (migration 0012), so a new one needs a migration too.

Priority.description: How soon a ticket needs attention.

Problem.description: Why a request failed, in words an agent can read.

ProposalView.description: A proposal as agents see it, with the names it refers to.

assets.description: For an assets proposal: the assets' names.

customer_name.description: For triage that opens a ticket: the customer's name.

rationale.description: Why it is proposed, by language; show the agent's language, else English.

services.description: For a services proposal: the services' names.

oneOf.description: A single sentence, taken as English.

RationaleInput.description: A rationale as an add-on sends it.

addresses.description: All the requester's addresses, the first registered first.

email.description:
The address that stands for the requester on this ticket, where a reply goes: the one they
last wrote from on it, else the one an agent last picked there, else the first they
registered.

last_picked.description:
On a ticket the requester has not written on, the address an agent picked for the last
reply there: the next reply goes there too unless the agent picks another.

reply_to.description:
The address the requester last wrote from on this ticket, where a reply goes. Empty when
they have not written on it: a reply then goes to the address the agent picks.

ticket_count.description: How many tickets the requester has, this one included.

addresses.description: The requester's e-mail addresses, the first registered first; there is at least one.

RequesterMove.description: What happens to the ticket's requester when the ticket moves to another customer.

body.description: Sent as a reply to the requester of every child that has one.

Role.description: A role as the agents' UI and the command line show it.

administrator.description: The built-in Administrator role: every permission, cannot be changed or removed.

agents.description: How many agents, deactivated ones included, have it.

default.description: The role new agents get when none is named.

permissions.description: Empty for the Administrator role, which allows every permission.

customers.description: How many customers use it, the help desk's own organization included.

runs_on.description: The assets the service runs on.

retired_at.description: When the site was retired: it stays visible but gets no new requesters or assets.

is_help_desk.description: Whether this is the help desk's own organization.

TicketDetail.description: A ticket with everything written on it.

assets.description: Assets of the ticket's customer the ticket is about.

children.description: The customers' tickets about the failure this ticket tracks.

oneOf.description: The parent ticket tracking the failure this ticket is about, if any.

proposals.description: Open proposals of add-ons such as the Assistant.

services.description: Services of the help desk the ticket is about.

number.description: The number agents and requesters see.

requester_email.description:
The address a reply goes to: the one the requester last wrote from on the ticket, else the
one an agent last picked there, else the first they registered.

allOf.description: An e-mail received from, or sent to, the requester.

oneOf.description: An e-mail received from, or sent to, the requester.

allOf.description: An internal remark, seen only by agents.

oneOf.description: An internal remark, seen only by agents.
